tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang la gnas dben pa dam tshig mi gtsang ba dang grib la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral zhing / bkra shis pa'i gnas su sa gzhi phyag dar dang chag chag legs par byas/ dkon mchog gi rten dang khyad par mgon po 'di'i bris sku sogs legs par bsham/ sa gzhi dri bzang gis byugs par maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mtha' ris skor ba bri/ lte ba la hūm̐ dkar po bri/ mtha' mchod pa dang spyan gzigs kyis bskor/ zas sna tshogs rnyed tshad bsham/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mañji la sogs pa'i thog tu/ gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum mar gyi nor bu dang / sbrang rtsi la sogs pas brgyan cing / mda' bya rgod ma dar dang me long dang mgon po 'di'i tsakli btags pa btsugs la bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon rang nyid mgon po'i bsgom bzlas dang / mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ dbus kyi hūm̐ las mgon por bskyed cing / ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gzhug pa dang / gsol 'debs mchod bstod/ gtor ma dbul ba rnams rdzogs par byas nas slob ma gcig khrus byas nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te mdun du 'dug pa la/ spyir mgon po thugs bskyed tshul dang / khyad par mgon po 'di nyid chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dgos 'dod ma lus pa stsol zhing dbul ba'i rgud pa mtha' dag las skyob pa dang / de'i gdams pa khyad par can bla ma rā hu las/ bla ma khyung po la 'phan yul jog po'i ri la bzhugs dus/ rgya gar nas nam langs pa la byon nas/ 'phan yul du nyi ma ma shar tsam la phebs pa mdzad de/ man ngag sgos skyel mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rnams bshad nas spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sems bskyed cing sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug

slob mas thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khyed zhabs pad mo spangs nas ni/ /sogs sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma rje btsun kha sar pa ni sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis sku bzhengs pa'i thugs kar yid bzhin nor bu/ de'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ /de'i thugs kar thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa slob mas bsgom zhing / de la mos 'dun drag po byed du gzhug slob ma tha mal du gnas pa'i snying khar thig le dmar po gcig gi steng du thig le dkar po gcig bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po'i sku ji lta bar bskyed pa'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du/ thig le dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po dang bcas pa sgom du bcug nas slob mas mos 'dun drag pos thar mo sbyar te/ bdag la sku'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs slob ma la bstim/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod nas ye shes kyi mgon po khyed kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di zhes bya ba'i phyi bzhin du rgyug la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'phrin las gang bsgo ba sgrubs shig ces bka' bsgo lan gcig bya'o/ /gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ bla ma la bdag la ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma kha sar pa ni'i thugs ka'i mgon po'i thugs khar hūm̐ dkar po la snying po yig 'bru bcu gsum gyis bskor ba bkod/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ste/

slob ma'i kha nas zhugs/ snying khar hūm̐ dkar po'i mtha' la 'khor bar dmigs nas sngags kyi rjes su zlos pa lan bcu gsum bya/ bka' sgo sngar ltar bya'o/ /de nas yang slob mas bdag la ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i pad nyi'i steng du thig le dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ dkar la 'tsher ba'i nang du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro de'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi bzhugs/ de dag bla ma'i shangs bug nas 'thon/ slob ma'i sna bug g.yon nas snying khar zhugs par bsams nas bka' sgo sngar ltar bya'o/ /yang slob mas/ bdag la ye shes kyi mgon po'i 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i rtsa 'khor bzhi dang smin phrag dang lngar mkha' 'gro sde lnga tshan pa lnga bsgom/ bla ma'i sku'i mkha' 'gro de dag las mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i mgon po'i zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag gi thugs kha nas kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nor lha sogs dang 'jig rten pa'i 'byung po mthu che ba rnams dang / bsgrub bya dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de dag bkug ste tshogs bdag la bstim/ bla ma'i rtsa 'khor bzhi yi mkha' 'gro rnams dbu ma'i nang na yar song smin phrag gi mkha' 'gro la thim/ de rnams las mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rigs de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa dbang du bsdus/ slob ma'i smin phrag gi mkha' 'gro lnga la thim par bsam mo/ /thod pa'i nang gi bum pa rin po ches khengs/ de lud pas thod pa khengs te lud par bsam mo/ /de nas sgrub pa'i lung sbyin/ tshogs byin gyis brlabs te rgyas par dbul zhing longs spyod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ bkra shis dang smon lam sogs bya'o// //maṅgalaṃ// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /bla ma mgon po ḍā ki'i zhabs btud nas/ /myur mdzad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/

/bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub pa'i thabs dgos pa kun 'byung ba'i dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub ma lus pa'i bdag nyid rin po che la don bzhi ste/ lo rgyus/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /de la 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyas par gzhung du gsal lo/ /dgos don ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra yis bdag khyung po rnal 'byor la brtse ba chen pos bod yul dbus su skyel du byon pa'i gdams pa'o/ /'di'i sbyor ba la gnyis las dang po bla ma mgon po dbyer med la sogs pa'i dbang zhu/ rgyud smin par byed pa yin pas dngos la gsol ba lo zla'i bar du gdab/ gnyis pa 'di rang gi bka' zhu/ gsum pa rin po che bsam 'phel 'di'i rdzas bsog pa ni/ bris sku bzhengs la rab gnas gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba la dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ bri lugs ni/ dbus lte ba dkar la pad ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mtshon no/ /de yan chad dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun no/ /bris sku bzhengs pa ni/ sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs 'di'i gzhung ltar bya/ ras gzhi'i skya zhal gyi gseb tu gri khrag sin dhu ra bla ma bzang po'i gdung rin po che sna tshogs rnams phye mar byas te sbyar ba skar ma rgyal gyi snga dro'i cha la byug de'i steng du mgon po'i rtsa sngags stong la sogs pa bzlas la byug de'i steng rtsa sngags si ti ma shong tshad bri/ lha bzo dbang po tshang ba/ phyug pa/ sdom pa dang ldan pa gcig gis kha byang du bstan la bri'o/ /de'i nyin par dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnad rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig btsal la zas sna tshogs bya'o/ /rab gnas spyir spyi dang mthun la/ yid la 'dod dgu stsol ba'i dngos grub zhu ba'i gsol ba ye shes pa la btab nas ye shes dgug gzhug brgya rtsa la sogs pa byed pa man ngag yin te 'di zhal shes yin no/ /dngos gzhi ni gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par gong gi bca' gzhi rnams legs par tshogs par byas te/

stan bde ba la 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /khyad par du sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i phyir du 'di bsgoms la gsol ba gdab pa dang bzlas pa sogs bya'o snyam du snying thag pa nas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par bya/ de nas tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa gcig bsgom/ de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog 'dra ba gcig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ma las yi ge hūm̐ dang bcas pa 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba gcig bsgom/ de la sems gtad de bsgoms pas de gnyis phrug gis 'dres pa las/ rang gi mdun du bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gyi nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pa nor bu/ gsum pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi dang po thod pa dang bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba brla g.yon pa la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pa rtse gsum/ tha ma lcags kyu snom pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ smad rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'o/ /zhabs dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal nas da lta rang 'byon pa 'dra ba/ 'gro 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i 'og na tshogs bdag re re mnan te/ kha dang bshang lam thams cad nas rin po che lhug lhug yod pa 'dra ba gnyis bskyed/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa gcig bsgom/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa snom pa/ zhabs gar stabs spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa khams gsum dbang du sdud pa gcig bskyed/

de'i snying khar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba gcig bskyed/ de las 'od 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal nas/ mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bya/ phyi mchod nang mchod dbul/ bsnyen pa'i dus su thig le de la rtsa sngags kyi g.yas nas bskor bar bsam la bsnyen sngags chu bo'i gzhung bzhin 'bum phrag gsum/ sngags gzhan dang mi bsre bar tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chad par bzlas so/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /gu ru ma hā kā la/ ha ri ni sa/ si ti dza/ yi ge 'bru bcu gsum/ gnad kyi gi gu bzhi dang zhabs kyu gnyis khams gsum dbang sdud kyi snying po'o/ /rtags ni/ bla ma dur khrod nas dngos su byon pa dang / rig ma mtshan ldan gyis dngos grub ster ba dang / zhal mthong ba dang khams gsum gyi sems can la dbang bskur ba rmi ba sogs so/ /nyams snang dang mngon sum du 'byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ zur gsum khru gang ba sha khrag gi rgyan dang / zas sna tshogs yod tshad bsags nas gtor ma snod khengs pa bshams la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag de la bris sku gzugs/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gtor ma/ mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga ci 'byor ba bsham/ gnad gcig la 'di'i lung zhu ba dang / sgrub pa byed dus sam/ tshes bcu la gtor ma byed dus zas sna tshogs 'byor tshad bsags la tshogs 'khor byed pa gal che/ rjes gnang zhu dus phyag rten gang phul ba de dngos grub kyi thog mar 'byung / de lta min na dngos grub yal gsung / dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /tshogs 'khor bshams dang bcas pas 'grub/ /ces yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud la sogs de yis bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi sems nyid thig le dmar por gyur pa snying kha na yod pa de la sems gtad de/

rtse gcig tu bzhag pas sems bzung bas gtan la phebs/ yi ge 'od du zhu ba yal song ba'i ngang la ci tsam gnas kyi bar la bzhag go /bzhag pa'i ngang nas rig rig pa de rig stong / 'gyu 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong / ma sgrib par gsal le ba de gsal stong / yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bas rmi lam gyi snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes pa de la gab ste ngo sprad pa de'o/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de'i steng nas nyal 'chag 'gro 'dug gi snang ba yang de kho na bzhin du nyams su len pa kho bo khyung po rnal 'byor gyi spyod tshul lo/ /sgrub pa 'di la gsol 'debs kho na gal che/ sgrub pa thon nas ye shes gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gtor ma che ba dngos grub tu len pa yin/ dam nyams kyi khar mi sbyin/ khyi dang ba lang la mi sbyin/ gtor ma gzhan rnams la mchod bstod gzhung bzhin byas la/ gtor ma dang / nang nub tsha ba g.yo dus dang / sbyin sreg gzhung bzhin byed dus su srog sngags la/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi sngags la pu tsa kha'i btags la/ de ma yin pa'i spyan 'dren/ bstod bskul gtor sngags mgon po'i gzhung bzhin byed pa gnad yin gsung / rjes bsngo ba dang mi dmigs pas rgyas 'debs shing / bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa bla ma mgon po mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ gser chos rnams kyi nang nas mgon po'i bka' rgya ma 'di rin chen brtson 'grus khyod la gtad do/ /chig rgyud las ma spel zhig ྀatsha// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kha tshar 'di la zhi ba nor du sgrub pa dang / drag po mthu ru sgrub pa gnyis las/ 'dir myur mdzad ces pa la brten nas zhi ba nor du bsgrub pa'o/ /de la dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / bum pa bca' ba dang / rdzas rnams bsog pa dang / lha bskyed pa dang / bsnyen pa skyel ba dang / rtags thon pa'o/

/de la dkyil 'khor bri ba gzhung ltar bya/ bum pa bcas pa dkyil 'khor bris pa'i steng du mañji la sogs pa'i khar bzhag gzungs thag nang rdzas sogs dang ldan par bya/ mchod gtor rgyas par bsham/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bum pa nang gzhal yas khang du bsam/ pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan te su hriḥ'am gha ta'i yig 'bru las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas yig 'bru la thim/ hriḥlas mgon por dkrongs kyis bskyed de/ de yang sku mdog dkar po/ /zhal gcig phyag drug pa g.yas dang po na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ gnyis pa na ne'u le/ gsum pa na bum pa/ g.yon dang po na gcod pa'i 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na ne'u le/ gsum pa na 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya mthe bong dang srin lag sprad pa'o/ /de nas/ ye shes dgug gzhug dbang skur rdzogs/ /byang chub sems kyis thog drangs la/ /yan lag bdun pa rdzogs par bya/ /de'i thugs ka'i hriḥlas ni/ /sngags la bsham bur bcas pas skor/ /gha'am hriḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ /spyan drangs gnyis su med pa bstim/ /gzungs thag bzung la snying po bzlas/ /lha yi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /'od byung bum pa'i rdzas la phog /rin po che dang bdud rtsir gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'od kyis bkug /nor gyi char pa phab byas te/ /bum pa'i nang du thim par bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ga na pa ta ye swāhā/ zhes bya ba yi snying po ni/ /smra bcad khams kyis thub tshad bgrang / /gsol ba 'debs lugs 'di bzhin bya/ /jo bo gzigs ldan bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /sbyin pa yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /'byor pa chen po'i dngos grub gsol/ /zhes gsol ba lan bdun gdab bo/ /rtags ni 'di ltar shes par bya/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su ni/

/nor rdzas 'bul ba byung na bzang / /zhal mthong ba ni mchog yin no/ /rmi lam rtags ni 'di lta ste/ /me tog 'thu dang btsas ma rnga/ /gzhan gyis zas nor 'bul ba dang / /phying ba gos dkar gyon pa dang / /chu yis longs spyod byed pa dang / /go cha dmag mi rmi na bzang / /sgrub pa thon pa'i dus su ni/ /bum pa'i nas ni rang nyid bza'/ /dngos grub blang ba'i don yang yin/ /ma grub lan gsum bskyar bar byas/ /dngos grub byung ba'i rdzas rnams la/ /rten bzhengs sgrub la brtson par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum ni mchod par bya/ /dbul po rnams kyi don yang bya/ /rang la zhen chags med par bya/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /kho yis yon bdag byed par 'gyur/ /'di'i yig sna yod pa tsam gyis bang so 'phel/ 'bru 'khrungs/ tshong legs 'ong / bsam pa 'grub bo/ /gtor ma che ba rtag tu gzung / gtor chung zhag re la nyi shu rtsa gcig re btang / sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su'o/ /bsgrub pa'i dus ni yar ngo'i tshes brgyad nas gnam stong gi bar la bya'o/ /gu h+ya sa ma ya/ ྀatsha// mgon po gzigs ldan thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa kha yangs shing mchu yongs su grags pa dang ldan pa/ ma chag ma gas lhan pa med pa dri ma dang bral zhing gtsang ba'i nang nas dkar mo sad la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral zhing / sbur sog dang sran ma dang rdo la sogs pa gcig kyang med cing sa la sogs pa dang bral ba/ phyug po'i bang mdzod nas byung ba'am yang na 'bras dkar mo ma grug pa ste/ de gnyis gang yang rung bas khengs par dgang / de'i nang du gser dngul mu tig byi ru mu men g.yu rnying zangs dang / pad ma ra ga dung la sogs pa'i rin po che rnyed tshad/ gos dar bzang po'i ras ma rigs mi gcig pa rnyed tshad/ ja dkar nag dang sha mar bu ram ka ra rgun 'brum la sogs pa'i zas sna bzang po rnyed tshad a ru ra rnyed tshad rnam rgyal lam/ ma rnyed na yang gzhan gser mdog bzang po dang /

bzang drug dang ga bur a ka ru tsan+dan dkar dmar dbang lag la sogs pa rnams zhugs cing / de'i dbus bum pa'i mgrin pa dang lte ba'i mtshams las cung zad mtho ba tsam du mgon po gzigs ldan gyi sku tsakli rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas pa zhal bum pa'i mchu la bstan cing bum rdzas kyi nang du nub pa bzhugs su bcug bum pa'i mchu rang la bstan/ zhag re la thun bzhir mgon po bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab/ gtor ma che ba'i nang du gtor chung btab/ gtor ma che ba ni nas dkar gtsang ma'i rjen btags la dpal bshos zur gsum khru gang ba/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bu ram gyis brgyan cing rtse mor mar gyi nor bu 'bar ba dang / mdun phyogs kyi logs la mar gyi hūm̐ dkar po chen po bris pa/ mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bcad kha nang du bstan nas bskor ba/ snod zangs kyi ka to ra la sogs pa gas chag dang bug pa dang / lhan pa sogs med pa'i chen por bya/ sku tsakli dang me long dang dar dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi mda' bya rgod ma sgros mes ma reg pa la brgyan pa'i mda' dar gzugs/ thun dang po la gtor chung gcig bla ma dang yi dam la dbul/ de ma gtogs thun bzhi po re re la gtor chung lnga lnga mgon po la dbul/ gtor ma che ba dang po nas snod khengs pa mtheb kyu snod las phyir ma thal ba bya/ gtor chen mgon por bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug de dang bum pa'i nang gi mgon po dbyer med par mos nas gtor chung dbul/ gtor chung ni gtor ma che ba'i mdun du snod gzhan bzhag pa'i nang du dbul du rung / gtor ma byin brlab gzhung bzhin no/ /gtor chung 'bul ba'i tshe/ re re nas lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste rtsa sngags si ti ma yi ge bcu pa'i mthar ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags nas dbul/sgrub pa thon kha'i thun tha ma la gtor ma che ba'i mgon po nam mkha' la bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma che ba legs par byin gyis brlabs te dbul/

thun thams cad la yang gtor ma che ba mtheb kyu re res gso/ sgrub pa'i bar la mtshams dam par bcad/ gzhan la gsang / ngag bcad/ sgrub rdzas phyir mi 'don/ stan mi sprug phyag dar mi bya/ dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bris rab gnas byas pa skud pa dmar pos dkris te bsgrub pa'i bar bum pa'i mgul bar btags pa la/ sgrub pa thon du nye ba'i thun tha ma'i tshe/ gtor ma'i mgon po nam mkhar btegs pa de la gtor ma phul tshar nas 'khor lo la bstims te/ 'khor lo rang gi lus la bcangs pas gang 'dod pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa thon nas thod pa dum bu gcig pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sngar gyi bum rdzas rnams nas dang bcas pas bkang ba'i nang du bum pa'i nang gi sku tsakli zhal thod pa'i dpral ba la bstan sku nas la nub pa byas te bcug pa rang gi nyal ba'i khang pa'am rang gi mchod khang du gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bzhugs su bcug pa'i mdun du 'dzin/ gtor bcas te/ nub re zhing gso zhing dbul/ gzhan pa'i rdzas kyi nas 'bras lhag ma rang kho nas longs spyod cing / sgrub pa'i gtor ma yang rang kho nas dngos grub du blang / bsgrub rdzas rnams dang po 'tshol ba'i tshe/ dam nyams dang grib can gyi lag nas byung ba dang ma 'dres pa bya zhing bsangs sbyangs legs par byas nas/ gu gul gyis bdug cing bum pa'i nang du gzhug par bya zhing / chang phud dang gtor che ma 'bags pa gal che/ zhal shes zhib par yi ger bkod pa yin pas ches shin tu gsang bar bya zhing / dpe su la yang mi bstan no/ /gu h+ye sa ma ya/ mgon po gzigs ldan 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu nyid las sbyor gyi tshe phyag mtshan sogs cung zad bsgyur ba tsam yin pas 'di la rjes gnang dang bka' logs su byed pa ni/ rjes gnang gi grangs la gtso bor byed pa rnams kyi rang bzo yin gyi bdag gi bla ma dag de 'dra mi bzhed do// ༈ /na mo/ dang por byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa grangs tshad rdzogs par bya/

de nas mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i bsnyen sngags si ti ma la bsnyen pa grangs thim pa/ dngos sam/ nyams snang ngam/ rmi lam gyi rtags gang yang rung ba thon nges pa bya/ de nas mgon po gzigs ldan dang / sngags ga na pa ti dang / rdzas bum pa dang / 'khor lo sogs la brten pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor rnams nyams su len pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /gtor ma lha ru bskyed pa yin na/ gtor ma'i logs la mar gyis hūm̐ bri/ lha ru mi bskyed pa'i 'dzin gtor nar ma sogs la mar dang bu ram gyis nor bu byed kyi/ hūm̐ bri ba ma yin no/ /gu h+ya sa ma ya ྀatsha/ mgon po'i sbyin sreg la gnyis las/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na/ thab la sogs pa thams cad spyi dang mthun par byas la me tog ser po la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas dang / mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa thab nang du 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i thugs ka'i me gru gsum gyi dbus su bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs byas te/ 'das pa'i me lha la bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad re dbul ba la/ sngags ni/ gu ru ma hā ka la ya/ ha ri ni si ti dza/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i 'khor longs spyod nor dang 'bru dang rin po che la sogs pa 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sngags re dang / rdzas re spel la dbul/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus/ 'jig rten pa la lhag ma phul nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa sogs cho ga spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dbang sdud la thab zla gam dkyil 'khor dmar po bris pa'am/ rtsig pa la bsreg rdzas sogs cho ga gzhan thams cad dbang gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang mthun pa dang / mgon po'i thugs kha'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa la bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i tshe/ gu ru ma hā kā la ya/ ha ri ni si ti dza/

che ge mo wa shiṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sngags re dang rdzas re spel nas 'bul ba'i dus su/ thugs kha'i mkha' 'gro ma las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bsgrub bya'i snying kha'am/ bha ga nas lcags kyus bkug ḍā ma ru'i sgras sems myos par byas te/ rang dbang med par bkug nas bdag gi rkang pa'i drung du bzhag par mos pa yang yang bya'o/ /thug pa bskol ba'i me la yang bskyed chog mdor bsdus byas nas/ tshwa dang phye mar la sngags dang bcas nas cung zad re 'bul ba'i sbyin sreg byar rung gsung mod/ rgyud sde ltar byas na legs sam snyam mo/ /ྀatsha// na mo gu ru/ chos skyong gi bum pa bca' ba'i thabs ni/ dang po bum pa so ma btang ba/ ma spyad pa tshad bre gang shong ba yan chad mchu can/ mgrin par bkra shis rdzas brgyad bris pa'i nang du chos skyong gi gzugs dang / rtsa ba'i sngags si ti ma'i mjug tu/ 'dod pa'i don zhu ba'i tshig rten 'di la gnas par mdzad du gsol/ gnas 'dir skye bo thams cad gus pas 'du zhing / 'byor pa thams cad chu bo'i tshogs bzhin 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa dang / bsrungs gcig la sogs pa btang la de 'dra ba mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa dang / ga bur/ gur gum/ tsan dan dmar po/ rang byung / ghi waṃ la sogs pas bris pa phyogs bzhi nas dbus kyi sku gzugs la kha bstan te bzhag sku rab gnas legs par byas pa'i zhal bum pa'i mchu la bstan/ bum rdzas rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / sman sna tshogs pa dang / 'bru sna tshogs pa dang / dar zab sna tshogs pa dang / mngar gsum la sogs pa'i zas sna tshogs pa dang / mgon po'i dam rdzas sna tshogs bcug la/ khengs par bkang / lug dar ma'i sog pa g.yas pa'i bal tshi med pas kha bcad/ de nas tshon sna lnga'i skud pas mgul ba bcings la/ de rjes kha'i steng nas rgya gram du bcing ngo / /de nas rang gi gnas khang gi mdzod dam/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang gi khyams kyi nang la sogs par gyang logs la thog mtshams las cung zad dma' bar khung bu gru bzhi pa dpangs su khru gang ba byas pa'i nang la zhal zhal legs po byas mtshal gyis byug

sin+dhu ra'i g.yung drung ris phyogs bzhir bris/ de'i nang du mthing shog la gser gyi pad ma 'dab brgyad bris pa gding / de'i steng du bum pa dar tshon lnga sna lnga'am tshon skud sna lngas brgya gram du bcings nas zhal khang pa'i phugs sam/ gtsang khang sogs la bstan la bzhag de'i steng nas dar nag gi gur dbub/ mdun du mar gyi gtor ma nor bus brgyan pa bzhag rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ lho phyogs bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po spyan drangs nas bum pa'i nang du bstims pa dang / gsol ba btab nas brtan par bzhugs pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lnga bcu'am nyer gcig bya/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ rang dang bum nang gi mgon po'i thugs kha'i mkha' 'gro ma las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lha dang mi'i rin po che dang 'byor pa'i khyad par ci yod pa bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang gi rin po che la sogs pa rnams la thim pa yang yang bsgoms nas/ bum pa'i mgul pa la gzungs thag btags la bzung ste/ rtsa sngags si ti ma stong bzlas/ bum pa'i nang gi nor zas rnams lud/ mgon po'i phyag gi bum pa dang / thod pa nas kyang lud/ ne'u le dang tshogs bdag gi kha bshang rnams nas kyang rin po che lhug lhug lud nas gnas khang dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i nang thams cad spyad pas zad mi shes pa tsam du khengs par bsams la/ bkra shis bya/ bum pa gtor ma dang bcas pa mi 'gul bar g.yam pa gru bzhi nang la g.yung drung ris bris pas kha bcad/ phyi nas zhal zhal byas te mi mngon par bya/ de ltar byas na gnas der 'byor pa zad mi shes pa 'byung ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ches zab pa yin zhing / zhal shes rnams kyang yi ger bkod pa yin pas dpe gzhan la mi bstan pa ches cher dam par bya'o// //gu h+ya sa ma ya/ /rgya rgya rgya a+thi+-itsha// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor/ PAGE
